description: This file is a JUnit test class for the ProgramWorkflowService in the OpenMRS API project. It contains multiple unit tests that verify the behavior of ProgramWorkflowService methods, including creating, updating, retrieving, retiring, unretiring, and deleting Program and ProgramWorkflow entities, as well as testing patient program state transitions and conversions.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowServiceTest
